Alger, 26 novembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, November 26, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The 11th edition of the International Exhibition of Industry and Subcontracting is taking place from November 23 to 26 at the SAFEX Exhibition Palace. This event brings together national and international companies to explore opportunities for industrial cooperation and local development.
Le salon ALGEST 2026, organisé par le Wo: The ALGEST 2026 exhibition, organized by the World Trade Center Algiers and the Algerian Subcontracting and Partnership Exchange, highlights the dynamism of local companies. Among the exhibitors, the start-up Fibonova, active since 2023, is presenting innovative electronic solutions. The company has collaborated with VMS Industrie to design a connected motorcycle dashboard, a first on the national market. This device allows users to manage certain functions, including receiving phone calls, directly via a dedicated mobile application.
L'intégration industrielle demeure un ax: Industrial integration remains a major focus for stakeholders present in the Aheggar pavilion. The Bounachada company, based in Sétif, illustrates this progress with an integration rate rising from 5% to 65% since its creation in 2010. Specialized in the production of vehicle cables, it employs 80 people and exports part of its production. However, the sector faces logistical and raw material supply challenges, impacting production capacities.
De son côté, VMS Industrie poursuit une: Meanwhile, VMS Industrie is pursuing a strategy to strengthen its local subcontracting network, currently counting 25 national partners. The objective is to boost the ecosystem surrounding motorcycle manufacturing, notably through the development of plastic injection and the production of brake pads. The 2026 edition of the exhibition also welcomes foreign delegations from Belgium, Spain, France, Tunisia, Slovakia, and Syria. These exchanges aim to foster skills transfer and access to new technologies for Algerian industrialists until the event closes on November 26.
